attempts.summary: Joined the private networks behind node1 (VyOS) and node2 (OPNsense) with a site-to-site WireGuard tunnel over the transit link between the two routers, so node3 (192.168.1.10) and node4 (192.168.2.10) now reach each other by their private addresses with traffic riding inside the tunnel. All 4 nodes were then restarted one at a time and full recovery was verified via changed boot identity plus re-established tunnel/routes/connectivity.
